name: Natural-language weather questions
description: Ask normal questions such as “Will it rain at 5 PM?”; n8n grounds the answer in the current weather payload before Gemini responds.

name: Rain questions
description: Answers rain-specific questions using hourly precipitation probability and rainfall values instead of guessing from the condition label.

name: Umbrella recommendations
description: Converts upcoming precipitation probability into a simple carry-an-umbrella decision with the reason shown to the user.

name: Simple weather explanations
description: Translates technical weather values into plain-language summaries for non-technical users.

name: Follow-up questions
description: Keeps the current weather and conversation context available so a user can ask follow-up questions without repeating the location.

name: Conversation memory
description: Stores lightweight conversation history in the browser and passes relevant context to the n8n AI workflow for the prototype.

name: Location-aware responses
description: Uses the searched city or coordinates as context for every forecast, risk and AI response.

name: Time-aware weather questions
description: Maps phrases such as “this evening” or “tomorrow morning” to hourly/daily forecast windows before producing an answer.

name: Compare two locations
description: Fetches a second city and compares temperature, rain probability and derived risk side by side.

name: AI-generated daily weather summary
description: Builds a concise daily briefing from live forecast, risk, activity and alert context.

name: Current temperature
description: Displays current temperature from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Feels-like temperature
description: Displays feels-like temperature from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Minimum / maximum temperature
description: Displays minimum / maximum temperature from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Humidity
description: Displays humidity from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Wind speed
description: Displays wind speed from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Wind direction
description: Displays wind direction from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Atmospheric pressure
description: Displays atmospheric pressure from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Visibility
description: Displays visibility from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Cloud cover
description: Displays cloud cover from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: UV index
description: Displays uv index from the live Open-Meteo weather payload and makes it available to the dashboard, risk engine and AI context.

name: Hourly forecast
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide hourly forecast and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: 24-hour forecast
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide 24-hour forecast and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: 7-day forecast
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide 7-day forecast and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Rain probability
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide rain probability and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Expected rainfall amount
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide expected rainfall amount and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Thunderstorm probability / signal
description: Detects thunderstorm weather codes in the hourly forecast and raises a thunderstorm signal used by the risk engine.

name: Temperature trend
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide temperature trend and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Wind trend
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide wind trend and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Sunrise / sunset
description: Uses Open-Meteo hourly/daily forecast arrays to provide sunrise / sunset and feeds the result into charts, planning and WeatherGPT answers.

name: Forecast comparison
description: Compares forecast signals and, where enabled, multi-model outputs so the UI can expose agreement instead of a single opaque forecast.

name: Heat risk score
description: Calculates a transparent heat risk score from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Rain risk score
description: Calculates a transparent rain risk score from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Lightning / thunderstorm risk
description: Calculates a transparent lightning / thunderstorm risk from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Flood-risk indicator
description: Combines heavy precipitation, storm and recent-weather signals into a prototype flood-risk indicator; it is not an official flood warning.

name: Strong-wind risk
description: Calculates a transparent strong-wind risk from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Visibility risk
description: Calculates a transparent visibility risk from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Outdoor safety score
description: Calculates a transparent outdoor safety score from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Travel safety score
description: Calculates a transparent travel safety score from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Overall weather-risk score
description: Calculates a transparent overall weather-risk score from forecast variables with deterministic JavaScript/n8n rules, then exposes the contributing reasons.

name: Explainable risk reasons
description: Shows which inputs contributed to the risk score so the score is explainable rather than a black box.

name: Official alert integration
description: Combines authoritative NDMA SACHET alerts with NASA EONET natural-event intelligence while keeping WeatherGPT-derived scores clearly separate.

name: District / state warning matching
description: Matches official alerts to the searched state/district and also checks NASA EONET events within a configurable geographic radius.

name: Extreme-rain alerts
description: Surfaces authoritative heavy-rain alerts when present and augments situational awareness with nearby EONET events.

name: Lightning / thunderstorm warnings
description: Shows official thunderstorm/lightning warnings when available and relates them to current forecast risk.

name: Heat-wave warnings
description: Shows official heat-wave warnings when available and compares them with the local heat-risk calculation.

name: Cyclone information scanner
description: Uses NASA EONET severe-storm events plus official warning data to provide a cyclone/severe-storm situational scanner.

name: Flood guidance
description: Provides prototype flood-safety guidance from forecast/risk inputs while keeping official warnings visually distinct.

name: Disaster response mode
description: Switches the assistant into disaster-response guidance mode with alerts, EONET events, safety actions and source-first language.

name: Emergency recommendations
description: Generates practical emergency precautions from the hazard type without presenting AI guidance as an official authority instruction.

name: Disaster event timeline
description: Builds a timeline/list of nearby NASA EONET natural events using event title, category, date, coordinates and source links.

name: Home location saving
description: Uses browser localStorage and n8n context to provide home location saving without requiring paid authentication or a cloud database.

name: Favourite locations
description: Uses browser localStorage and n8n context to provide favourite locations without requiring paid authentication or a cloud database.

name: User weather preferences
description: Uses browser localStorage and n8n context to provide user weather preferences without requiring paid authentication or a cloud database.

name: Daily weather briefing
description: Generates a reusable daily summary containing weather, risk, useful time windows and active alerts.

name: Morning forecast brief
description: n8n can execute a scheduled morning briefing for the configured home location using the same zero-cost data stack.

name: Evening forecast brief
description: Produces an evening-oriented summary using the upcoming nighttime and next-morning forecast window.

name: Personal rain alert
description: Uses the saved rain threshold/preferences to decide whether a browser rain alert should be offered.

name: Personal heat alert
description: Uses apparent temperature and saved preferences to generate a personal heat alert.

name: Severe-weather browser alert
description: Uses browser Notification permission to surface severe-weather reminders without a paid SMS/WhatsApp gateway.

name: Personalized recommendation engine
description: Combines saved location, preferences, risk and activity scores to personalize recommendations.

name: Activity Intelligence Engine
description: One explainable activity-intelligence feature with eight profiles: Running, Walking, Cycling, Cricket, Football, Photography, Laundry Drying and Outdoor Event. Each profile applies activity-specific weather penalties without being counted as a separate major capability.

name: Best outdoor time
description: Scans the next 24 hours in 3-hour windows and selects the lowest-risk outdoor window based on rain, wind, heat and UV.

name: Activity recommendation engine
description: Transforms weather and risk variables into activity-specific advice instead of showing only raw weather values.

name: Interactive weather map
description: Displays the searched location and intelligence layers on an interactive Leaflet/OpenStreetMap map.

name: Temperature map layer
description: Builds temperature points/tiles from the n8n map-grid workflow for a prototype temperature layer.

name: Rainfall map layer
description: Builds precipitation values over a local map grid for a prototype rainfall layer.

name: Wind visualization
description: Displays wind values/direction from forecast-grid data to provide spatial wind context.

name: Cloud layer
description: Uses cloud-cover/condition data in the map-grid layer to represent cloud conditions.

name: Warning-region layer
description: Places matched official-warning and NASA EONET hazard locations on the map without relabelling derived risk as official.

name: Current-location marker
description: Marks the user-selected or geolocated coordinates on the interactive map.

name: Forecast timeline slider
description: Lets the map/grid data be associated with forecast time so the prototype can step through upcoming conditions.

name: Animated weather cards
description: Uses animated cards, counters, hover motion, background weather shapes and scrolling marquee effects to make the dashboard feel live.

name: Weather charts
description: Shows hourly temperature and rain charts with Chart.js for fast visual interpretation.

name: Travel mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for travel mode.

name: Agriculture mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for agriculture mode.

name: Disaster response mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for disaster response mode.

name: Student / college mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for student / college mode.

name: Outdoor sports mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for outdoor sports mode.

name: Marine weather mode
description: Uses Open-Meteo Marine data through n8n for wave/wind context; it is prototype guidance, not certified navigation data.

name: Event planner mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for event planner mode.

name: Health / comfort mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for health / comfort mode.

name: Smart city mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for smart city mode.

name: Research mode
description: Reuses the same verified weather/alert context but changes the assistant and scoring priorities for research mode.

name: Multilingual assistant
description: Lets the AI response language switch between English, Tamil and Hindi while keeping the same grounded weather context.

name: Voice questions
description: Uses the browser Web Speech Recognition interface to convert spoken questions into text at zero API cost where supported.

name: Voice weather briefing
description: Uses browser speech synthesis to read WeatherGPT answers aloud where supported.

name: Weather-source citations
description: Keeps source labels visible for Open-Meteo, NDMA SACHET, NASA EONET, OpenStreetMap and AI-derived results.

name: Multi-model forecast verification
description: Queries multiple numerical weather-model outputs through the Open-Meteo model interfaces and compares their key forecast values.

name: Forecast confidence score
description: Converts cross-model agreement into a prototype confidence indicator so users can see when models disagree.

name: Citizen weather reporting
description: Accepts a local community weather report through an n8n webhook and labels it as community-supplied, never official.

name: Weather anomaly detection
description: Compares recent observations/forecast past-days values with current conditions to flag unusual changes.

name: Recent-history analytics
description: Uses Open-Meteo Forecast past_days data for recent-history trends without requiring the paid long-term historical API.

name: Experimental local nowcast model
description: Runs a clearly labelled experimental trend/persistence nowcast in n8n. It is a prototype model and is never presented as a meteorological authority forecast.

name: Weather Route Intelligence
description: Builds an origin-to-destination weather corridor, samples weather along the path, highlights the highest-risk point and visualizes the corridor on a map. It is weather planning, not turn-by-turn navigation.

name: Campus Weather Mode
description: Turns the current local forecast into a campus-day timeline for commute, midday movement, sports/outdoor time and evening departure with explainable GO/CAUTION/AVOID signals.

name: Event Weather Planner
description: Evaluates a selected event date, start time and duration inside the available forecast window and returns an outdoor-event suitability score, key risks and a backup-plan recommendation.
source: Open-Meteo hourly forecast + WeatherGPT event scoring

name: AI Trip Weather Planner
description: Compares weather across multiple trip stops for a chosen forecast date, ranks the stops by weather suitability and can ask the grounded Gemini workflow to produce a concise trip-weather plan.
workflow: 01 Weather Core + 02 Gemini Copilot + 14 Decision Studio

name: Weather Scenario Simulator
description: Lets the user change hypothetical temperature, rain, wind, UV and thunderstorm values and recomputes a simulated WeatherGPT risk score beside the real current risk. Simulations are clearly labelled as non-forecasts.

name: Heat Stress Intelligence
description: Combines apparent temperature, humidity, UV and wind into an explainable outdoor heat-burden score and general comfort precautions. It is not a medical diagnosis or clinical heat index service.

name: Indian Languages Mode
description: Lets the WeatherGPT copilot answer and speak weather briefings in multiple Indian languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese and Urdu.
source: Gemini grounded copilot + browser speech APIs
